messages:
emma: Quick design nit from security QA — current label under Project Settings reads `Encryption: KMS` and it's coming off terse/confusing. Also retention dropdown shows "30 days / 90 days / Custom" with no hint why shorter retention might not be available per region. Screenshot: https://rwd.slack/XYZ123 :eyes:

raj: Totally — 'KMS' is pretty jargony for a settings page. Recommend `Customer‑managed keys (KMS)` with a short tooltip. Tooltip trigger needs to be accessible (icon button, aria-describedby). :a11y:

oliver: Implementation note: tooltip content should be plain text (for i18n). We can add a `data-testid` for the tooltip and a11y attributes. Regarding regions, right now we sort by latency; for Compliance view we might want to surface compliant regions first.

aria: From an accessibility POV: tooltip must be focusable (tabindex=0) and use `role="button"` with `aria-expanded` state. Current key icon color fails contrast on white — need 4.5:1 min. Avoid parentheses-heavy labels for screen readers.

emma: Proposed concise tooltip copy: `Customer-managed keys (KMS): Use your cloud KMS to control encryption keys for stored artifacts. Required for some compliance certifications.` Is that too long?

oliver: Shorter: `Customer-managed keys enable you to use your cloud provider's KMS to manage encryption keys for stored data.` That fits the tooltip and translations better.

raj: For retention UX: add helper text under the select: `Retention limits vary by region — see Security docs`. Don't put links inside select options (bad for a11y).

aria: Agree with helper text. Make the link descriptive (eg. "Security docs: retention by region") and ensure it opens in a new tab with `rel="noopener"`. Also make sure the helper text is read on focus (aria-live polite) when a user tabs into the select so screen readers know why options are disabled.

emma: Audit-log copy: the UI currently shows `Encryption key changed` which is ambiguous. Suggest `Encryption key rotation initiated` or `Encryption key updated` depending on the action.

oliver: Example audit event we emit: `{"event":"kms_key_rotate","user":"oliver","resource":"project-123","when":"2025-05-12T14:03:00Z"}`. In the UI show `Encryption key rotation initiated` and include key alias in metadata but redact full ARN by default.

aria: UI should show truncated ARN with a tooltip containing the full ARN for keyboard users. Add a copy button with aria-label `Copy full key ARN`. Ensure copy success message is announced (aria-live).

raj: Tiny UX nit: region dropdown — in Compliance mode show regions with compliance badges first (EU, UK, etc.). Maybe surface a small badge `Compliance-ready` next to label. Use `aria-hidden` for purely decorative badges.

emma: Good plan. I'll update the mockups: label -> `Customer‑managed keys (KMS)` (using a non-breaking hyphen), add helper text under retention select, audit log copy -> `Encryption key rotation initiated`, and truncation rules for ARNs. @oliver can you add the audit event field names to the API spec?

oliver: Yep, I'll add them to the contract and open a tiny PR with the copy + a11y attributes.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued for branch feature/kms-copy by oliver.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: feature/kms-copy. ETA ~ 12m. :rocket:

aria: Once the PR is up ping me for accessibility review. I'll validate keyboard focus, aria labels, and contrast.

emma: Thanks everyone — leaving this as a design nit thread. I'll attach updated mock: https://rwd.figma/kms-copy-v2 :sparkles:
